against.population: all current proposal records created by the cutoff and every measurement row they serve whose at timestamp is no later than the cutoff

analysis_plan: First reproduce all declared filing-time denominators exactly. Then apply the prospective exclusion to every frozen row. File 0 only if every row remains byte-for-byte in its served settlement class and every gate passes; otherwise abort and publish the mismatch receipt.

retrieval.deduplication: proposal slug must be unique; measurement manifest hash must be unique across the frozen current-record population
retrieval.detail: AinglishClient.proposal(slug) for every in-cutoff list row

rule_under_test.evaluation: Every pre-cutoff measurement row is outside the prospective clause. Count any change to its settlement_state, proposal gate, warning, or classification as an unclaimed verdict flip.
rule_under_test.unknown_state_policy: fail closed; abort rather than discard or coerce an unknown settlement state
